title: Universal Search Audit and Proposals

audit_findings.issue: Missing Cmd+K / Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut to focus the universal search input.
audit_findings.recommendation: Add a keyboard event listener in keyboard-shortcuts.js or universal-search.js to intercept Cmd+K / Ctrl+K, prevent the default browser behavior, and focus the search input field.

audit_findings.issue: Debounce is implemented with a 150ms delay, which might be too short for large datasets, and there is no loading indicator.
audit_findings.recommendation: Increase debounce time to 300ms for better performance with large datasets or complex fuzzy matching. Add a loading state if search takes longer.

audit_findings.issue: Current search uses simple string inclusion (.includes(q)). This is strict substring matching, not fuzzy matching.
audit_findings.recommendation: Implement true fuzzy matching (e.g., using Fuse.js or custom Levenshtein distance) to handle typos and approximate matches.

audit_findings.issue: No arrow key (Up/Down) navigation or Enter key selection for search results in the dropdown.
audit_findings.recommendation: Add keydown event listeners on the input field to navigate results with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, highlight the selected item, and trigger selection with Enter. Add 'Escape' to close dropdown.

audit_findings.issue: Search terms are not highlighted in the result titles or subtitles.
audit_findings.recommendation: Update renderSearchDropdown to wrap matching substrings in <mark> tags or similar highlighting elements.

proposed_changes: Implement Up/Down arrow key navigation in the search dropdown.
Implement Enter key selection for the active dropdown item.
Implement Esc key to close the dropdown.
Highlight matched text within the search results.
